entities.summary: Elena Vladimirovna Khrulyova, better known by the stage name Elena Vaenga, is a popular Russian singer, songwriter and actress. Her style of singing is author song, folk rock, chanson and others. Vaenga's repertoire includes her own compositions, traditional ballads and folk songs, and songs derived from classical Russian poems. In 2025, she was awarded as a Merited Artist of the Russian Federation.
